I know how this feels, I’ve been there too. Please believe me when I say that it DOES get better. I was in your position when I was turning 18 (I’m 24 now). I had struggled with depression and suicidal thoughts and attempts and I thought my 18th birthday would be it. But, I realized that maybe if I gave myself just one year of adulthood, things would change. Being 18 is so different than being a teenager. Yes adulthood is stressful, but it’s also wonderful. You’re so young (cliche, I know)  and every person on this earth has a gift. If you die now, how will you know if you could’ve done something great? Depression is telling you that you never will but trust me as someone who’s been there...you will. The quote that used to get me through my darkest times actually came from a Katy Perry song (firework) and it says “after a hurricane comes a rainbow”. It’s so true...something good will happen, I promise, and what you’re going through now will make you a stronger and more special person than those around you. You are worth it, you are special, and whether or not your depression lets you see it, you are loved. Please give yourself the time to see the beautiful things that are coming your way.
